ammonia.reason: No ripening proteolysis or deamination; ammonia not detected in fresh acid curd.

animal_barnyard.reason: No p-cresol or indole reported; pasteurized cow milk and clean lactic starter.

bitter.reason: No aged hydrophobic peptides; minimal rennet and no proteolysis in unripened gel.

blue_moldy.reason: Trace 2-heptanone 16 ug/kg and 2-nonanone 11 ug/kg, ~1000x below blue cheese; no Penicillium.

browning.reason: Very high moisture 82.7% and pH 4.52 prevent Maillard; fresh unheated curd does not brown.

buttery.reason: Low diacetyl 33.6 ug/kg plus acetoin 95 ug/kg from lactococcal citrate fermentation.

cheesy_sweaty.reason: Low butanoic 2604 ug/kg and hexanoic 852 ug/kg with minimal lipolysis and no aging.

creaminess.reason: Smooth acid casein gel at 82.7% moisture gives spoonable creaminess despite only 2.73% fat.

crumbliness.reason: Homogeneous acid gel with no pressed curd junctions or calcium-paracasein fracture.

firmness.reason: Very high moisture acid gel with demineralized casein at pH 4.52, no pressing or ripening.

floral_honey.reason: Trace phenylacetaldehyde 3.15 ug/kg and 2-phenylethanol 2.85 ug/kg from phenylalanine catabolism.

fruity.reason: No ethyl butanoate/hexanoate found; methyl ketones 2-22 ug/kg far below fruity thresholds.

goaty.reason: Cow milk with no 4-methyloctanoic/4-ethyloctanoic acids; low total fat 2.73%.

malty_nutty.reason: No Strecker aldehydes 2-/3-methylbutanal found; no aging for maltol/nutty pyrazines.

melt.reason: Acid pH 4.52 demineralized casein precipitates and expels whey instead of flowing on heating.

mushroom_earthy.reason: No 1-octen-3-ol/one reported; no Geotrichum/mold lipoxygenase pathway in fresh quark.

oil_off.reason: Only 2.73% fat entrapped in high-moisture gel; no free oil formation on heating.

smoky.reason: No guaiacol reported and unsmoked make; no wood-smoke phenols.

sour_vinegar.reason: pH 4.52 lactic acid plus acetic acid 6350 ug/kg from mesophilic starter gives bright sour.

stretch.reason: No pasta-filata kneading; acid-precipitated casein lacks intact calcium-crosslinked fibers.

sulfur_cooked.reason: No methanethiol/DMS/DMDS found; pasteurized but not high-cooked curd, no sulfur catabolism.

sweet.reason: Residual lactose/carbs 4.6% with very low salt 0.7% gives mild sweet against lactic sour.

umami.reason: No ripening proteolysis to free glutamate; fresh curd low in savory peptides.
